text:
Amir (AE): FYI got flagged by a customer on the Starter -> Sustained change. Theyhave a live POC that ends in 10 days and want to lock pricing for 12 months.
Keeley (Sales Ops): Do we have an official guideline for POCs ending <30 days? I thought grandfathering applies, but need exact wording to put in the quote notes.
Ravi (Pricing): Grandfathering applies to renewals signed within 30 days of rollout. For quoting, mark `grandfathering:yes` and add ARR impact.
Nora (Deal Desk): We need the signed PO date on the quote to validate. Also: exceptions with >$200k ARR require Deal Desk review + lead approval.
Jules (RevOps): Small note: the CPQ mapping changed last night; if youuse an old template the `grandfathering` flag wont carry into billing. Use the latest template v2026-03-19.
Becky (Customer Success): Can someone draft a one-line customer message we can send? Customer-facing wording needs to be simple.
Amir (AE): Suggest: "We will honor your current committed pricing for renewals executed within 30 days of our pricing update. Please let us know if you'd like us to generate a renewal quote." Thoughts?
Keeley (Sales Ops): Good start. Add instruction: "Request renewal quote via your AE or renewals@redwood.com" so they know where to go.
Ravi (Pricing): Fine. Also add note: any active promo codes tied to Starter will be converted to a one-time credit unless listed in the exceptions sheet.
Amir (AE): They asked about APAC billing — will the conversion to one-time credit affect invoicing region?
Jules (RevOps): Region doesn't change invoices; credits will be applied as a separate line item. Finance approved the approach.
Nora (Deal Desk): Operationally, please add rows to the exceptions sheet with: account name, renewal signed by date, ARR delta, AE, notes, and attach PO when available. URL in pinned thread.
OpsBot: Automated message: exceptions sheet uploaded https://drive.company/pricing/pricing-v4-exceptions.csv — please use that file.
Keeley (Sales Ops): Small snafu: someone added a row without ARR. Nora, can we enforce validation? Weshould block saving if ARR is blank.
Nora (Deal Desk): Ican add a validation rule in the sheet. Will add `ARR required` and `priority` flags for >200k.
Ravi (Pricing): For discount conversion: old flat tiers -> new pct bands. Mapping table posted in docs but quick ref: flat-5pt -> 6-15%, flat-10pt -> 16-30%. Use conservative mapping and note in quote comments.
Amir (AE): If a customer wants a formal amendment to the MSA, who signs off? Legal?
Becky (Customer Success): Legal handles MSA amendments. Weshould offer the short clause and an amended SOW where needed.
Jules (RevOps): Tech checklist: CPQ template, billing metric rename, analytics tag rename, and migrations. Ideployed CPQ to sandbox — running smoke tests now. Will report back in 10m.
Keeley (Sales Ops): Who owns the AE one-pager? I can draft it but need final language on grandfathering and promo conversion.
Ravi (Pricing): Ican review and add the discount band examples.
Nora (Deal Desk): Quick ask: prioritize platform strategic deals — tag `priority` in the sheet and notify Deal Desk via DM for a fast-track.
Amir (AE): Done — added row for AcmeHealth, tagged priority.
OpsBot: Automated message: sandbox CPQ deploy completed with warnings — missing `grandfathering` field in 3 legacy templates. See logs https://ci.company/builds/2345
Jules (RevOps): Rolling back those 3 templates to v2026-03-10 and re-running migration. Will keep you posted.
Keeley (Sales Ops): Also: AE playbook update required. Will push a PR to internal docs and request approvals.
Becky (Customer Success): Iwill notify customers in the POC bucket and offer to create renewal quotes. Can someone tag the list?
Amir (AE): Tagging list: @Becky I added AcmeHealth and two others to the POC report.
Ravi (Pricing): Final reminder: exceptions must include ARR delta and be submitted within 30 days of rollout to qualify. Beyond that, v4 pricing applies.
Nora (Deal Desk): Confirmed. Weare standing by to process exceptions with 48h SLA.
Amir (AE): Thanks team. Will send the customer line and follow up after renewal quote is sent.
Keeley (Sales Ops): Meeting in 45m to finalize AE materials — invite sent.
Jules (RevOps): Smoke tests pass after rollback. No further action required on my end.
OpsBot: Automated message: pricing-v4 announcement published to internal docs https://internal.redwood/pricing/v4 — changelog attached.
